description: Read a UTF-8 workspace file or a read-only Thread resource by a 1-based line range and return its full-content SHA-256 version hash.

propertyDescriptions.path: Workspace-relative file path, or the exact thread-resource://<resource-id>/content.md URI supplied with an attachment or fetched page.
propertyDescriptions.startLine: The first 1-based line to return. Omit it to begin at the start of the file.
propertyDescriptions.endLine: Final 1-based line. Omit for the configured locating window (default 100 lines). Explicit ranges allow up to 1000 lines by default, subject to the separate read-result token budget. Inspect actual endLine and nextStartLine.

guidance: If location is unknown, use search_files or a small read to locate it, then read a coherent section in one larger range. Known locations and small files may be read directly. Thread resources are immutable and never authorize a workspace edit. Avoid many tiny consecutive reads. Inspect truncation and nextStartLine. Absolute host paths are not accepted.
